title: Third Conditional: Rules and Examples — Quiz 82A

## Third Conditional: Rules and Examples

Use the past perfect in the if clause and would have with the past participle in the main clause.

### Lesson focus

1. If you had asked me, I would have helped you.
2. The situation refers to a past condition and result that did not happen.

### Practise with the image

Read the full lesson image for the original exercise, notes and any answer key shown. Write your own answers before checking a key. A key labelled for another quiz belongs to that quiz.
